dataset_scope: event-specific local research input; not registered in the shared runoff_datasets.csv

provider.name: Copernicus Climate Data Store
provider.dataset: ERA5-Land hourly data from 1950 to present
provider.source_semantics: ERA5-Land accumulated runoff; source time attribution caveat is tracked in KG-0019.

workflow.execution_status: Existing researcher-generated data and logs were inspected; no download or conversion was run for this task.

requested_settings.domain_coordinate_convention: Requested geographic bounds; actual grid centers and cell-edge bounds are reported separately below.

observed_local_data.data_git_status: Originals, converted NetCDF, and logs are ignored by inp/.gitignore; keep local and do not commit.

observed_converted_netcdf.long_name: runoff accumulated over each input timestep
observed_converted_netcdf.observed_time_sequence: Continuous hourly labels with no duplicate or missing records across the 20 output files.

step11_input_matrix.compatibility_assessment: The observed Rhine subset uses the same 0.1-degree regular centers and N-to-S latitude ordering as the ERA5land_global grid definition. The existing map-specific matrix/diminfo pair is available. The matrix was not regenerated or value-validated in Step 12.

derived_cama_flood_input_settings_report.unit_interpretation: mm accumulated per one-hour record divided by 3,600,000 to produce m/s.

event_context_period.meaning: Core intense-rainfall interval documented in Step 1; not the full impact or simulation period.

initial_candidate_analysis_period.meaning: Step 1 candidate analysis window; not the selected runoff acquisition interval.

runoff_acquisition_period.meaning: Researcher-selected data acquisition period to provide pre-event preparation time; not proof of adequate spin-up.

period_context.evaluation_after_2021_07_20: Extend runoff input dates before evaluating later dates.

checks_passed: 20 raw and 20 converted daily filenames cover every date from 2021-07-01 through 2021-07-20.
All 20 raw files contain 24 hourly source timestamps; their complete sequence is continuous, and raw coordinate arrays match the converted files.
All converted files have shape (time=24, lat=91, lon=111), and their timestamps form one continuous 480-hour label sequence.
Converted file longitude/latitude coordinate arrays are identical across all 20 days and follow the reported 0.1-degree order.
All 20 download logs report completion and all 20 conversion logs report an output write.
Observed converted variable is float32 runoff(time,lat,lon), units mm, with fill and missing value 1e20.
not_checked: No independent numerical reconstruction of the converter output from raw accumulations was performed.
No model reader or simulation test was run.
No independent verification of ERA5-Land physical time attribution was performed.

scientific_limitations: KG-0019 remains open: ERA5-Land 00 UTC accumulation refers to the preceding 24-hour interval; the conversion first-record handling and period-boundary coverage remain unresolved.
The 2021-07-01 start provides a pre-event interval but does not establish adequate spin-up.
The requested CDS area, returned cell centers, and outer cell edges are distinct; use the observed coordinates for spatial mapping.
NetCDF structure and matrix-grid geometry do not prove a successful or scientifically valid model input mapping.
registry_decision: Not added to inp/runoff_datasets.csv because this is an event-specific local dataset, not a reusable distributed product.

required_decisions: check actual model settings against the helper metadata

observed_source_netcdf.observed_time_sequence: Continuous hourly labels over 20 dates; no duplicate or missing hourly labels.

conversion_method.method: Difference accumulated source runoff within UTC calendar-day groups, then convert metres to millimetres per input timestep.
conversion_method.first_record_of_each_day: Kept by the current default converter setting.
conversion_method.negative_differences: Current accumulation is substituted; negative increments are clipped by default.
conversion_method.source_and_output_temporal_grouping: Daily file grouping does not perform temporal averaging.
conversion_method.caveat: This describes the retained implementation; it does not resolve KG-0019 first-record or physical interval attribution.
